include.name: release-artifacts
include.run:
node scripts/ci/release-packages.mjs pack --tag=v0.0.0 --out="$RUNNER_TEMP/packages"
node scripts/ci/release-packages.mjs verify --out="$RUNNER_TEMP/packages"
node scripts/ci/release-packages.mjs publish --dry-run --out="$RUNNER_TEMP/packages"
node scripts/ci/release-charts.mjs placeholder-manifest > "$RUNNER_TEMP/image-manifest.json"
node scripts/ci/release-charts.mjs package --tag=v0.0.0 --manifest="$RUNNER_TEMP/image-manifest.json" --out="$RUNNER_TEMP/charts"
node scripts/ci/release-charts.mjs verify --tag=v0.0.0 --manifest="$RUNNER_TEMP/image-manifest.json" --out="$RUNNER_TEMP/charts"
